title: The Geometry of Dilation- and Shear-Deformed Spaces
summary:
This paper develops a deformation-field geometry for spaces whose local frames may undergo internal dilation, compression, and shear. The basic datum is an admissible dilation-shear field $P$ over a selected metric-compatible reference geometry $(M, ar g, ar
abla)$. It represents the induced metric by $g=P^T ar gP$ and compares tangent data through the reference representative $ ar V=PV$. The covariant derivative associated with the natural connection is defined by \[
